_comment: DBine's UI languages, the one list the scripts read (scripts/i18n/check.py, scripts/changelog.py). Spanish is the source. 'plurals' are the CLDR plural categories i18next uses for the language (Intl.PluralRules). 'changelog_after': the language's changelog/CHANGELOG.<code>.md must have every version newer than this one (the language shipped with the next release); without it, every version. check.py also verifies that the lists in the code (web/src/i18n, crates/dbine-ai, src-tauri updates) match this file.
